name: round5_imagenet_pretrained
description: ConvNeXt-Tiny initialised from the authors' ImageNet-1k weights (convnext_tiny_1k_224_ema.pth, Liu et al. 2022; SHA-256 14f3164e3ea6ac32ab3f574f528ce817696c9176fad4221e0a77a905a7360595), three-slice context as RGB, fine-tuned for 40 epochs at peak LR 5e-5 with final-epoch weights. Folds 4 and 5 as in round 4, with the strong and the scanner augmentation profiles. Primary outcomes: validation slice accuracy and scan AUROC on scans acquired 2017-2019.

cases.purpose: ImageNet-1k ConvNeXt-Tiny fine-tuned, strong augmentation, fold 4; compare with CV_tiny_context_fold4 (round 3)
